meta.name: using-git-worktrees
meta.description: Use when starting feature work that needs isolation from current workspace or before executing implementation plans - ensures an isolated workspace exists via native tools or git worktree fallback

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建隔离工作区进行特性开发
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在当前工作区外独立开发新功能
copy.tagline_en: Create isolated workspaces for feature development
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to work on a new feature without affecting your current workspace

howto.what: 当开始新功能或执行实现计划时，自动检查是否在隔离工作区，若不是则创建隔离区（优先用原生工具，否则用 git worktree），然后运行项目依赖安装和测试，确保基线干净。
howto.when: 当你提出需要隔离的新功能工作，或要求执行实现计划时触发。默认会在开始前询问你的同意。

say.text: 开始一个新功能，帮我设置隔离工作区。
say.note: 技能会检测当前状态并创建隔离环境。

say.text: 执行新功能实现前，确保有一个独立工作区。
say.note: 技能会检查是否已隔离，否则创建。

say.text: 我要做特性开发，请给我一个隔离的工作树。
say.note: 技能会自动选择原生工具或 git worktree。

howto.what_en: When starting feature work or before executing implementation plans, automatically check if already in an isolated workspace; if not, create one (prefer native tools, fallback to git worktree), then run project setup and baseline tests to ensure a clean starting point.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you request a new feature that needs isolation or ask to execute implementation plans. It will ask for your consent by default before creating a workspace.

say_en.text: Start a new feature and set up an isolated workspace for me.
say_en.note: The skill will detect current state and create isolation.

say_en.text: Before implementing the new feature, ensure an isolated workspace exists.
say_en.note: It will check for existing isolation or create one.

say_en.text: I want to work on a feature in an isolated worktree.
say_en.note: It will use native tools or fallback to git worktree.
